messages:
Nina: Quick Q - I upgraded to a refundable fare because of schedule changes. Refund shows up on the airline but our policy says non-refundable fare for economy unless pre-approved. Will the refund to my personal card be forfeited or is that credited back to the company since I used company card originally?

Rohan: If the original booking was on the company card, refunds should go back to the company. If you purchased the refundable upgrade on your personal card, submit a claim and include the refund notice; Finance will net the refund against the original expense. If there's confusion, attach the itinerary with fare breakdown.

Nina: Okay that's clear. I paid the upgrade on personal card and airline issued refund back to my card. Ill submit the claim with docs. Also, does the per-diem apply if the flight is canceled mid-travel?

Maya: Per-diem pro-rate rules apply for partial travel days. If you were delayed overnight due to cancellation and had meal expenses, you can either claim actual receipts or use the per-diem for the extra day. If refund nets negate your expense, finance will adjust reimbursement accordingly.

People Ops Bot: Checklist: 1) Upload refund confirmation screenshot, original booking invoice, and any upgrade receipts; 2) Tag as "fare-refund-netting"; 3) Finance will apply any netting during review.

Finance Bot: Claim 2001122334 received. We will validate the airline refund and offset reimbursements. If the refund exceeds reimbursed amounts, finance may request repayment or adjust against future expenses.
